summary: The agent executed a rigorous and disciplined replication of Paper P in an isolated virtual environment using downloaded MUSE embeddings. It successfully reproduced the headline Spanish original MWEAT (3.6918), grammatical gender classification accuracies (0.9140/0.8258 SVC; 0.9170/0.8260 LDA), and original word translation P@k across all four language pairs. It demonstrated that the paper's published 0.389 cosine depends on the notebook's centering bug combined with LinearSVC, and correctly documented that Table 1 and Table 2 mitigations are unreproducible from the release due to missing debiased/aligned vectors. All results were calibrated carefully, distinguishing exact matches from close estimates and blocked targets without unwarranted claims.
